nav.label: Main navigation
foot.note: Sites are published on your own servers. This interface is reachable only from the internal network.
pager.label: Pages
error.notfound.title: Page not found
error.notfound.text: This page does not exist or you have no access to it. Check the address or go back to your sites.
error.forbidden.title: Request rejected
error.forbidden.text: The form has expired or was sent from another site. Reload the page and try again — nothing was changed.
error.generic.title: That did not work
login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Publish a site in a minute
login.lede: Drop an archive with finished pages and get a link you can send to colleagues and clients.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator for a new sign-in link.
invite.title: Set your password
invite.heading: Welcome
invite.lede: Choose a password and you will be signed in right away.
invite.invalid.title: This link does not work
invite.invalid.text: The invite link has expired, was already used or was mistyped. Contact your administrator for a new one.
invite.password.hint: At least 10 characters. A phrase of several words is easiest to remember.
invite.mismatch: The passwords do not match. Type the same password in both fields.
sites.title: My sites
sites.atlimit: You have reached the maximum number of sites ({limit}). Delete a site you no longer need or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
sites.empty.title: Nothing here yet
sites.empty.step1: Create a site — it gets a permanent address at once.
sites.empty.step2: Drop a zip archive with an index.html file onto its page.
sites.empty.step3: Share the link. New versions are published at the same address.
site.field.title: Title
site.slug.hint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3–63 characters. The address will look like name.{domain}.
site.slug.clear: Leave it empty to remove the short address.
site.created: Site created. Now upload an archive with its files.
site.delete.mismatch: The site was not deleted: the text you typed does not match its title or address.
site.deleted: Site “{title}” deleted. Its addresses no longer open.
site.unpublished.hint: The addresses show an empty page for now — upload an archive.
site.delete.title: Delete site
site.delete.text: The site's addresses stop working immediately and become free for others. This cannot be undone.
site.delete.confirm: To confirm, type the title “{title}” or the site address
deploy.title: Publish a new version
deploy.hint: ZIP or TAR.GZ up to {size} with index.html at the root. The previous version stays in the history.
deploy.failed: The archive could not be uploaded: the connection dropped. Check your connection and try again.
deploy.wrongtype: This is not an archive. Choose a .zip, .tar.gz or .tgz file.
deploy.nofile: No file selected. Choose a zip archive with your site and press Upload.
deploy.howto.title: How to prepare the archive
deploy.howto.1: Select all the site's files (not the folder that holds them) and compress them: on macOS use Compress, on Windows Send to → Compressed (zipped) folder.
deploy.howto.2: The home page must be called index.html. If the whole site sits in one folder inside the archive, that works too.
deploy.howto.3: Shortcuts and symbolic links inside the archive are not supported; system files such as .DS_Store are skipped.
history.title: Release history
history.preview.label: Open release {id} at its own address
history.empty: No releases yet. Upload the first archive and it will appear here.
connect.title: Connect AI
connect.lede: Set it up once, then publish sites by saying “publish this site” in Claude Code or Codex.
connect.install.title: Install the dropsite program
connect.install.text: Open a terminal and paste the command for your system.
connect.install.check: To check: “{cli} version” should print a version number.
connect.token.title: Issue an access key
connect.token.text: The key (token) links the program to your account. Name it after the device, for example “Work laptop”.
connect.token.name: Name
connect.issued.title: Key “{name}” is ready.
connect.issued.warn: Copy the command and run it in your terminal. The key is shown only once — it will not be visible after you reload the page.
connect.agent.title: Teach your assistant to publish
connect.agent.text: Add the instructions for your assistant — it will check the program and publish the right folder by itself.
connect.claude.text: Create a file at this path and paste the text below into it:
connect.codex.text: Add this snippet to the AGENTS.md file at the root of your project:
connect.use.title: Ask it to publish
connect.use.text: “Publish this site” — the assistant replies with a link.
connect.tokens.title: Your keys
connect.revoked: Key revoked: programs using it can no longer publish.
users.title: Users
users.invite.title: Link for {email}
users.invite.text: Send it to the user so they can set a password. The link works once and is valid until {expires}. It cannot be shown again — issue a new one if needed.
users.create.hint: No email is sent: pass the invite link on yourself.
users.blocked: {email} is blocked: sign-in and access keys no longer work.
search.label: Search
allsites.title: All sites
allsites.apex.confirm: Serve this site at {domain} (if the root belongs to another site, it moves here)
allsites.apex.unconfirmed: Tick the confirmation box — without it the address does not change.
allsites.apex.cleared: The domain root is unbound from “{title}”.
allsites.transfer.label: Transfer to user (email)
allsites.transfer.nouser: No active user with the email “{email}”.
audit.title: Audit log
settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Limits for every user. Changes apply immediately, without a restart.
settings.max_site_bytes.hint: Total size of one release after unpacking.
settings.max_file_bytes.hint: No larger than the site size.
settings.max_files.hint: How many files one release may contain.
settings.keep_releases.hint: How many versions are kept for rollback. At least 2.
settings.reserved.hint: One per line. Nobody can take these short addresses; ones already in use stay with their owners.
settings.saved: Settings saved and already in effect.
err.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a minute; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
err.not_found: Not found: it does not exist or you have no access to it.
err.invalid_input: Check what you entered: one of the values is not accepted.
err.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait about {minutes} min and try again.
err.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
err.email_invalid: This does not look like an email address. Check the spelling, for example name@company.com.
err.password_too_short: The password is too short: use at least {min} characters.
err.invite_invalid: The invite link has expired or was already used. Ask your administrator for a new one.
err.user_blocked: The user is blocked. Unblock them first.
err.self_action_forbidden: You cannot do this to your own account.
err.slug_invalid: A short address may contain only Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 63 characters, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
err.slug_reserved: The address “{slug}” is reserved. Choose another one.
err.slug_taken: This address is already taken. Choose another one.
err.title_invalid: The title must be one line of at most {max} characters.
err.site_limit_reached: Site limit reached ({limit}). Delete a site you no longer need or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
err.deploy_not_ready: This release can no longer be restored: its files were cleaned up.
err.no_previous_deploy: There is no earlier release to roll back to.
err.token_name_invalid: The key name must be one line of at most {max} characters.
err.setting_invalid: The value of “{key}” is not allowed. Check the limits next to the field.
err.archive_unsupported_format: This file is neither zip nor tar.gz. Compress the site's files into a zip archive and upload it.
err.archive_corrupt: The archive is damaged or the upload was interrupted. Create the archive again and re-upload it.
err.archive_too_large: The site is too large: the limit is {limit}. Shrink images and videos or remove files you do not need.
err.archive_file_too_large: The file “{path}” is larger than the {limit} limit. Compress it or remove it from the archive.
err.archive_too_many_files: The archive has too many files: at most {limit} are allowed. Remove what you do not need.
err.archive_absolute_path: The archive contains a file with an absolute path “{path}”. Create the archive again from the site folder.
err.archive_path_traversal: The archive contains a path with “..”: “{path}”. Such archives are not accepted — create it again from the site folder.
err.archive_link: The archive contains a shortcut (link) “{path}”. Replace it with the real file and create the archive again.
err.archive_special_file: The archive contains a special system file “{path}”. Keep only regular files and folders.
err.archive_bad_name: A file name in the archive is not allowed: “{path}”. Rename the file (no control characters or duplicates) and create the archive again.
err.archive_no_index: There is no index.html at the root of the archive — it is the site's home page. Put index.html at the root of the archive (not in a subfolder) and upload again. The site still shows the previous version.
err.archive_empty: The archive is empty. Add the site's files to it, including index.html.
users.tokens_revoked: Revoked {count} access keys of {email}. Tools and assistants can no longer publish on their behalf.
forms.title: Submissions
forms.lede: Forms on the site's pages send submissions here. Every submission is stored and forwarded to the connected channels.
forms.channels.none: No channels yet: submissions are stored here but not forwarded anywhere.
forms.delivery.none: No channels at the time — the submission was only stored.
forms.altcha.label: Require the anti-robot check (Altcha)
forms.altcha.hint: Submissions without a solved Altcha challenge are rejected. Turn on once the form has the widget.
forms.empty.how: To receive submissions, add a form to a page:
forms.issued.secret.warn: It is shown only once: save it in the receiver. The X-Dropsite-Signature header carries the HMAC-SHA256 of the body.
forms.issued.link.text: Open the link in Telegram and press Start in the chat that should receive submissions. The link works for 30 minutes.
forms.issued.link.after: After pressing Start, reload this page: the channel becomes active.
forms.verify.label: Confirmation code
forms.channel.waitlink: Waiting for Start to be pressed in Telegram via the issued link.
forms.channel.codesent: Code sent. Enter it to confirm the channel.
forms.channel.verified: Channel confirmed: new submissions will arrive there.
forms.channel.disabled: Channel turned off: submissions are not sent to it.
forms.add.telegram.hint: Bot @{bot}. Without a chat ID you get a binding link — the easiest way. For a group: add the bot to the group and enter its chat ID.
forms.add.telegram.off: No Telegram bot is configured. Ask an administrator to add a bot token in Settings.
forms.add.email.hint: A confirmation code will be sent to this address.
forms.add.email.off: E-mail is not configured. Ask an administrator to set up SMTP in Settings.
forms.add.webhook.hint: POST with the submission JSON and an HMAC-SHA256 signature. Internal addresses are not allowed.
forms.howto.text: Paste the example into a page. The hidden _hp field catches bots, _next is the page shown after sending, the Altcha widget is harmless while the check is off.
forms.admin.saved: Form settings saved and already in effect.
forms.admin.title: Form submissions
forms.admin.lede: Transports site owners use to receive submissions. Secrets are stored encrypted and are never shown after saving.
forms.admin.unreadable: A stored secret cannot be decrypted (the database was restored without state/secrets.key). Enter the token and password again.
forms.admin.token.hint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token.
forms.admin.altcha.hint: Base Altcha difficulty: at 5000 a visitor waits a few seconds. Repeated checks from one IP within 10 minutes get 4 times harder each.
err.form_invalid: The form data was rejected: check the fields.
err.form_too_large: The form contains too much data (over 64 KB).
err.form_unsupported_type: The form was sent in an unsupported format.
err.form_origin_mismatch: The form was sent from another site.
err.form_captcha_invalid: The anti-robot check failed or expired.
err.channel_invalid: The channel was not added: check the address or chat ID. For Telegram, open the bot and press Start first.
err.channel_unavailable: This channel is not available: it is not configured or the code could not be sent.
err.channel_limit_reached: The site already has {limit} channels. Remove one first.
err.channel_code_invalid: The code is wrong or expired. Remove the channel and add it again to get a new code.
err.telegram_token_invalid: Telegram rejected the bot token. Copy it from @BotFather again.
